answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using time-locked stake bonding. Before transacting across the economic canyon, each prospective node must deposit cryptocurrency collateral into a walnut escrow contract. This forces adversaries to incur a verifiable opportunity cost of locked capital per identity, neutralizing any gale of ephemeral clones. However, this mechanism penalizes capital-poor autonomous agents and remains vulnerable to well-funded adversaries.
